description: CutGeek removes the background from a photo on your own machine and hands it back at the original resolution as a transparent PNG. The free web services downsize the result, watermark it, or keep the full-size version behind a subscription; this one does none of those. It can work through a folder of images in one run. Images are processed locally and never uploaded. An internet connection is only used to download a model when you ask for one, or when you click Check for updates.

name: Cutter
description: Cutter is a free and open-source reverse engineering platform powered by rizin. It aims at being an advanced and customizable reverse engineering platform while keeping the user experience in mind. Cutter is created by reverse engineers for reverse engineers.

name: cv
description:
The cv command line interface reads and writes files in the .cv open file
format. A .cv file is a valid PDF/A-3u document that also carries a clean
Markdown copy, an optional HTML copy, and pre computed BGE M3 semantic
vectors as PDF Associated Files. One file opens visually in any PDF
reader, parses cleanly in any applicant tracking system, embeds on any
webpage, and answers semantic queries from any retrieval pipeline.

The CLI ships the full reader and writer paths: pack a PDF plus text
representations into a .cv, extract a payload, inspect XMP metadata,
validate against the cv 1.0 specification, and run semantic search over
the embedded vectors using the Hugging Face Inference API.

The full specification, the JavaScript and Python SDKs, the web
component, and the LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations live at
https://github.com/cvfile/cv.

name: cv4pve-autosnap
description:
cv4pve-autosnap is an automatic snapshot tool for Proxmox VE virtual machines and containers.
It creates snapshots with retention policies and supports flexible targeting patterns including
ID/name based selection, bulk operations, and pool-based selections.

Features:
- Automatic snapshot creation with retention policies
- Support for VMs and Containers
- Flexible VM selection (ID, name, patterns, pools)
- Hook script execution (pre/post snapshot)
- Multiple snapshot labels for different schedules
- Clean command to remove old snapshots
- Status command to view existing snapshots

name: cv4pve-botgram
description:
cv4pve-botgram is a Telegram bot for managing Proxmox VE clusters.
It allows you to monitor and control your virtual machines and containers
through Telegram chat commands with secure authentication.

Features:
- Manage VMs and Containers via Telegram
- Secure chat ID-based authentication
- Real-time status monitoring
- Start/Stop/Reboot operations
- Node management commands
- API explorer for advanced operations
- Custom command aliases
- Service and console modes

name: cv4pve-cli
description:
cv4pve-cli is a comprehensive command-line interface tool for Proxmox VE that provides
powerful management and automation capabilities for your virtualization infrastructure.

Features:
- VM/Container management and automation
- Snapshot and backup operations
- Resource monitoring and management
- Cluster operations
- Advanced scripting capabilities
- Multiple output formats (Text, HTML, JSON, Markdown)
- Batch operations support
- Integration with Proxmox VE API

name: cv4pve-diag
description:
cv4pve-diag is a comprehensive diagnostic tool for Proxmox VE that performs health checks
and system analysis on your virtualization infrastructure.

Features:
- Node health and status monitoring
- VM/Container diagnostics and configuration validation
- Storage capacity and performance checks
- Replication and backup status verification
- Snapshot age monitoring
- Multiple output formats (Text, HTML, JSON, Markdown)
- Customizable severity thresholds
- Support for ignore patterns

name: cv4pve-metrics-exporter
description:
cv4pve-metrics-exporter is a Prometheus metrics exporter for Proxmox VE that provides
comprehensive monitoring data for your virtualization infrastructure.

Features:
- Prometheus metrics export for monitoring and alerting
- Node health and status metrics
- VM/Container resource usage and performance metrics
- Storage capacity and usage metrics
- Replication status monitoring
- High Availability (HA) resource tracking
- Subscription status monitoring
- Disk SMART health monitoring
- Customizable endpoint (host, port, URL path)
- API token support for secure authentication
- Multiple host support for HA configurations

name: cv4pve-node-protect
description:
cv4pve-node-protect backs up Proxmox VE node configuration files over SSH.
It connects to one or more nodes, archives the paths you choose into a tar.gz per node,
organises the archives into timestamped folders and applies a retention policy automatically.

Features:
- Multi-node backup in a single run
- Selectable backup paths
- Configurable retention policy
- SSH key or password authentication (with password-from-file support)
- Custom SSH port per host
- No agents installed on the nodes — only SSH access required

name: cv4pve-pepper
description:
cv4pve-pepper is a tool for launching SPICE remote-viewer to connect to Proxmox VE
virtual machines and containers.

Features:
- Launch SPICE remote-viewer for VMs and containers
- Simple and easy to use
- Integration with Proxmox VE API

name: cv4pve-report
description:
cv4pve-report exports your entire Proxmox VE infrastructure to a single
navigable Excel file — nodes, VMs, containers, storages, users, firewall
rules, backup jobs, resource pools and more. Every row is a hyperlink to
its detail sheet.

Features:
- Single .xlsx file with one sheet per node, VM and storage
- Fully navigable — summary rows link to detail sheets
- Cluster: users, API tokens, TFA, groups, roles, ACL, firewall, backup jobs, replication, SDN, pools
- Nodes: services, network, disks, SMART, RRD metrics, APT updates, SSL certificates, tasks
- VMs/CTs: config, network, disks, RRD metrics, backups, snapshots, firewall, QEMU agent info
- Storages: content inventory, RRD metrics
- Three profiles: Fast, Standard, Full
- Works with a read-only API token, no root access required

name: cv4pve-vdi
description:
cv4pve-vdi is a desktop VDI client for Proxmox VE that provides a graphical
interface to browse, filter and connect to virtual machines and containers
via SPICE and RDP — without opening the Proxmox web UI.

Features:
- Card and list view for VM/CT browsing
- SPICE console launch via remote-viewer
- RDP launch via mstsc or xfreerdp
- VM/CT power control (Start / Shutdown)
- Real-time CPU and RAM usage bars
- Auto-refresh every 10 seconds
- Filter by node, status, type and tags
- Multi-host support for multiple clusters
- Light and Dark themes

name: Cwdio File Manager
description:
Cwdio File Manager is a keyboard-first, dual-pane file manager for Windows. It pairs an orthodox
two-pane workflow with embedded multi-session terminals (cwd-synced), a cancelable/resumable operation
queue, archive browse + write (ZIP/RAR/7z/tar), remote filesystems (SFTP/FTP/FTPS), rich previews
(PDF/media/code/hex), bulk rename, duplicate finding, and a plugin platform. Every feature is free —
there is no paid tier, no account and no telemetry.

name: Cyber Intel Classification Banner
description:
Cyber Intel Classification Banner (CICB) is a comprehensive solution for displaying security classification levels on Windows systems.

Features:
- Multi-screen support with independent classification per monitor
- Server-client architecture for centralized management
- Configurable banner colors, sizes, and text
- Pre-configured templates for common classification levels (UNCLASSIFIED, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET, TOP SECRET, etc.)
- Active Directory/LDAP integration support
- CCM (Classification Configuration Manager) for easy setup
- Auto-startup options for both client and server
- Silent installation support for enterprise deployment

Use Cases:
- Government and military installations
- Defense contractors (CMMC, NIST SP 800-171 compliance)
- Classified information handling facilities
- Secure compartmented information facilities (SCIF)
- Research institutions handling controlled information

name: Cyber Prot
description: Cyber Prot is a Windows anti-ransomware tool that adds a behavioral protection layer alongside your existing antivirus. It monitors process activity and file changes in real time to help detect and block suspicious encryption attempts before they cause damage. Free for Personal and Small Business use on up to 5 computers. Business and Enterprise use requires contacting Next IT Computers.

name: Cyberduck
description: Cyberduck is a libre server and cloud storage browser for Mac and Windows with support for FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, OpenStack Swift, Backblaze B2, Microsoft Azure & OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox.

name: CyberHive Connect
description:
CyberHive Connect provides a Trusted Area Network - a zero trust software-defined mesh network secured with quantum-safe cryptography.
Connect features high performance with low latency and fast reconnects. It is simple and scalable, with easy setup and administration.

name: CyberPower PowerPanel Personal
description: Monitors UPS vitals: electrical power supply, voltage, power condition, remaining battery runtime, UPS load from a CyberPower UPS System

name: cybr-cli
description: A "Swiss Army Knife" command-line interface (CLI) for easy human and non-human interaction with CyberArk suite of products.  Products supported include Identity Security Platform Shared Services (ISPSS), Privilege Cloud (PCloud), Self-Hosted Privilege (PAM), Central Credential Provider (CCP), Conjur Secrets Manager, and Cloud Entitlments Manager (CEM).

name: CycloneDX CLI
description:
The CycloneDX CLI tool currently supports BOM analysis, modification, diffing, merging, format
conversion, signing and verification.

Conversion is supported between CycloneDX XML, JSON, Protobuf, CSV, and SPDX JSON v2.3.

name: CycloneDX Generator (cdxgen)
description: Generate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for most applications and container images with a single command. Generate Operations Bill of Materials (OBOM) for Linux and Windows hosts. Integrate with any CI/CD pipeline. Automatically submit the generated BOM to your dependency track server for analysis.

name: Cyme
description: A modern cross-platform lsusb that attempts to maintain compatibility with, but also add new features. Profiles system USB buses and the devices on those buses, including full device descriptors.

name: CyrFlip
description: CyrFlip is a tiny Windows tray utility. It shows the active keyboard layout right next to the blinking text caret - on the mouse I-beam and the tray icon too - so you always know which layout you are typing in, with its own colour for each of the 13 curated languages and a frame when CapsLock is on. A global hotkey transliterates a selection between QWERTY and JCUKEN in place, a second one fixes an accidental CapsLock, and a table of layout pairs adds as many "from layout to layout" conversions as you need, each with its own chord and each working in both directions. A settings window replaces the Windows language pane: install, reorder and remove keyboard layouts, choose the switch chord, and assign per-language shortcuts that Windows itself handles. An optional Quick launch module turns your programs, scripts and yt-dlp downloads into scenarios started from the tray, from a global hotkey of their own, or from the taskbar Jump List. A built-in translator, optional as well, sends a selection to Ollama - a free program you install separately on your own computer - and shows the translation in a small window at the mouse pointer; it stays off until you enable it and by default talks only to localhost, so no text leaves your machine. Extras: an optional DPAPI-encrypted clipboard history with search, two keep-awake switches, and an interface available in 13 languages. Ships as a single portable exe with no installer and no runtime dependencies.

name: D-Link DWA-X1850 Driver
description:
Driver for the D-Link DWA-X1850 Wi-Fi AX USB device.

The installer installs (among other things) the Realtek RTL8852AU driver version 5001.15.116.0, which may or may not also work with non-«D-Link», AX1800-marked Wi-Fi 6/AX adapters.

Although a 5001.15.134.0 driver version exists, it is unknown if any device manufacturers distribute that version without Cisco plugins.

name: daan
description: Daan（答案）是一个简洁轻量的、用于与大型语言模型（LLM）交互的客户端，提供流畅高效的 AI 体验。兼容 OpenAI GPT 系列及兼容 API。

name: Daily Prayer Timer
description: Daily Prayer Timer is a comprehensive Windows application designed to help you keep track of Islamic prayer times with a premium UI, accurate calculations, and smart notifications.

name: Dalux (MSI)
description: Dalux BIM viewer is the world’s best at handling multiple complex BIM models. Have confidence that you can see and engage with your project information, regardless of project size, model complexity, or access device!

name: Dante Via
description: Use Dante Via to connect local headphones or speakers directly to a Dante network, so you can easily monitor Dante devices and channels from anywhere on the system with no need for dedicated hardware.

name: Dante Virtual Soundcard
description: Dante Virtual Soundcard is a software application that turns your PC into a Dante-enabled device, allowing Dante audio traffic to be transmitted and received between other Dante-enabled devices using the standard Ethernet port.

name: Dark7zip
description: Dark7zip is project to experiment with dark mode via darkmodelib library for 7-Zip and its fork 7-Zip-zstd.

name: darkbright-helper
description:
A hotkey-driven monitor brightness tool for Windows. From 100% down to 1% it sets the
hardware backlight over DDC/CI (VCP code 0x10), so the panel actually gets darker. Once
brightness reaches 0% and the screen is still too bright, a black fullscreen overlay with
variable opacity keeps dimming past the hardware minimum.

Multi-monitor aware: a hotkey affects the monitor the mouse pointer is currently on.
Monitors are identified by EDID rather than by OS handle, so the configuration survives
replugging and port changes. An OSD shows the current value, and a system tray icon
offers live per-monitor status plus warnings while degraded.

A settings window covers every option, and the interface is available in nine
languages, following the Windows display language by default.

Performs no network I/O of any kind: no telemetry, no update checks, no crash reporting.

Note: the overlay does not cover exclusive-fullscreen games or certain Windows system UI
such as the taskbar and Start menu. Laptop internal panels do not speak DDC/CI and are
not supported. The binary is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen warns on first run.

name: darktable
description: darktable is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers. It manages your digital negatives in a database, lets you view them through a zoomable lighttable and enables you to develop raw images and enhance them.

name: DarkThumbs
description:
Thumbnail preview support for ebooks and various archive formats in Windows File Explorer. V2.0 adds DJVU and 7Z/CB7 support! V2.1 fixes broken CB7 support, adding it as a selectable option.

Supported formats:
- EPUB, FB2, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3)
- DJVU / DJV, CB7, CBZ. CBR
- 7Z, RAR, ZIP (ZIP, PHZ, GGB)
- PHZ, GGB

name: Darshan Player
description:
Darshan Player is a lightweight open-source media player for Windows, built on LibVLC. It plays
common video and audio formats without extra codec packs, including MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM,
MP3, FLAC and more.

Features include a 10-band equalizer with presets, subtitle loading with delay adjustment and
appearance options, multiple audio and subtitle track selection, chapter navigation, playback
speed control, A-B loop, frame stepping, crop and deinterlace, picture-in-picture, playlists
with shuffle and repeat, and resume where you left off.

name: Dash
description:
Dash opens apps, files, folders and websites from one search box without leaving the keyboard.
Press the global hotkey, type a few letters, and the command completes inline.
Add aliases for the terms you naturally type, do quick calculations, and customize commands, icons and settings.
Dash only launches the commands you have given it, so results are predictable and instant.

name: Dash by Docker
description: Dash by Docker gives agents safe, isolated environments to work in.

name: Dashboard
description:
SanDisk Dashboard is software that checks on SanDisk and Western Digital drives in Windows. Tools for checking health, firmware versions and updates are included.
SanDisk Dashboard features the ability to:
- Maintain peak performance of the SanDisk and Western Digital solid state drives (SSD) in Windows® operating systems
- Analyze drives (including the disk model, capacity, firmware version, drive health and SMART attributes)
- Update drive firmware

name: Dashcam Viewer
description:
Dashcam Viewer is powerful, state-of-the-art software with unique and functional features that will unleash your dashcam’s full potential.
Let us keep track of things so you can have peace of mind.

Dashcam Viewer is available on Mac and Windows and is compatible with over 140 different dashcam models. It is the player of choice by many dashcam manufacturers and vendors. Even if your dashcam is not listed below, it may still be compatible. Download the Free version and give it a try.

- Easily export portions of clips into short videos or images for easy viewing. You can also combine multiple videos into one.
- All videos are added to the movie list for easy access. Consecutive videos are combined into Trip Lists.
- Dashcam Viewer identifies sudden changes in volume in your videos so that events like collisions and horns are easy to find.

The free version is fully functional but is limited to loading 2 videos at a time. Purchasing a license removes the limitations and the splash screen.
- Support for 2 Videos
- Support for 2 Geotags
- Audio Event Detection for 1 Video

name: Dashlane
description: Dashlane is a cross-platform subscription-based password manager and digital wallet application available on macOS, Windows, iOS and Android. Dashlane uses a freemium pricing model which includes both a free tier and a premium subscription.

name: Dashlane CLI
description:
Dashlane CLI is a command line interface for Dashlane. It allows you to interact with your Dashlane account, and to manage your passwords, secure notes, secrets and personal data.

Dashlane CLI also allows you to access team admin related features such as accessing your team’s member list, Dark Web Insights reports and audit logs.

name: Data Assistant
description:
Data Assistant——以结构化的方式快速创建测试数据，可以导出为 SQL、CSV、HTML、XML 文件。

- Windows 原生：Data Assistant 使用 Windows Native 技术，这保证软件具有很小的安装体积和较高的响应速度。
- 快速生成：创建小型或大型数据集，用于表、结构和脚本的快速原型设计或压力测试。
- 真实数据：为任何开发、测试或演示目的生成大量、异构、真实的数据，而不是仅仅通过复制和粘贴创建重复的不切实际的文本字段。
- 基于文档：您创建的数据结构被完整保留，可以为不同的目的创建不同的数据集。
- 导出数据：可以导出 JSON、SQL、CSV、HTML、XML，并且可以将数据结构转换为 Java、C#、TypeScript、JSONSchema 代码。
- 字段微调：可以对任何字段使用可选的前缀和后缀；对随机数据填充字段，指定长度或长度范围；对数字字段指定范围；对日期范围使用格式化字符串决定输出内容。

name: DataGrip（抢先体验计划）
description: JetBrains 为 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的 SQL 开发的强大 IDE。

name: DataLimiter
description: DataLimiter is a Windows command-line tool that manages Windows Firewall policy and rules to limit outbound network traffic to Chrome browsing, DNS, and DHCP.

name: datamitsu
description:
Configuration management and binary distribution tool.
JavaScript-configurable tool orchestration for linting and development workflows.

name: Dataplicity CLI
description: Dataplicity CLI provides command line access to Dataplicity setup, authentication, organisation, device, terminal, remote command, port forwarding, fleet job, and logging workflows.

name: DataPress
description: DataPress turns Parquet and Delta datasets in object storage into fast, typed HTTP APIs — JSON and Arrow IPC — backed by DuckDB or Apache Arrow + DataFusion. The single `datapress` binary bundles both engines and selects one at runtime from `server.backend` in your datasets.toml.

name: DataSpell
description: JetBrains DataSpell is an IDE for data analysis with Jupyter notebooks and SQL-cells, interactive Python scripts, dbt Core, SQL databases support, and low-code features.

name: DataSpell (EAP)
description: JetBrains DataSpell is an IDE for data analysis with Jupyter notebooks and SQL-cells, interactive Python scripts, dbt Core, SQL databases support, and low-code features.

name: DataWarrior
description: DataWarrior is an open-source program for data visualization and analysis with chemical intelligence. DataWarrior combines dynamic graphical views and interactive row filtering with chemical intelligence. Scatter plots, box plots, bar charts and pie charts not only visualize numerical or category data, but also show trends of multiple scaffolds or compound substitution patterns. Chemical descriptors encode various aspects of chemical structures, e.g. the chemical graph, chemical functionality from a synthetic chemist’s point of view or 3-dimensional pharmacophore features. These allow for fundamentally different types of molecular similarity measures, which can be applied for many purposes including row filtering and the customization of graphical views. DataWarrior supports the enumeration of combinatorial libraries as the creation of evolutionary libraries. Compounds can be clustered and diverse subsets can be picked. Calculated compound similarities can be used for multidimensional scaling methods, e.g. Kohonen nets. Physicochemical properties can be calculated, structure activity relationship tables can be created and activity cliffs be visualized.

name: DATEV Belegtransfer
description: Mit dem Programm DATEV Belegtransfer können Sie Ihre Belege nach DATEV Unternehmen online übertragen. Zusätzlich bietet das Programm einen Überwachungsmodus an, der Belege automatisch nach DATEV Belege online oder in die DATEV Personalakte überträgt.

name: Datovka
description: Datovka je multiplatformní desktopová aplikace pro přístup k datovým schránkám. Uživatelské rozhraní aplikace se inspiruje poštovními klienty. Datovka je svobodný software chráněný licencí GNU GPL verze 3. Instalační balíčky pro Linux, Windows a macOS jsou volně ke stažení.

name: datui
description: Datui is a high-performance terminal UI for exploring and analyzing datasets.

name: DaVinci Resolve RPC
description:
Runs silently in the system tray and shows your current DaVinci Resolve project
and active timeline on your Discord profile in real time. Supports automatic
startup with Windows and requires no administrator rights.

name: Davis WLL
description: Free windows app for Davis WLL

name: DavMail
description: Ever wanted to get rid of Outlook ? DavMail is a POP/IMAP/SMTP/Caldav/Carddav/LDAP gateway allowing users to use any mail client with Exchange and Office 365, even from the internet through Outlook Web Access on any platform, tested on MacOSX, Linux and Windows.

name: DB Browser for SQLite
description: DB Browser for SQLite (DB4S) is a high quality, visual, open source tool designed for people who want to create, search, and edit SQLite or SQLCipher database files. DB4S gives a familiar spreadsheet-like interface on the database in addition to providing a full SQL query facility. It works with Windows, macOS, and most versions of Linux and Unix.

name: DBase Video & Music Downloader
description:
DBase Video & Music Downloader accepts media URLs from any of the ~1,750
sites yt-dlp supports, reads the available formats, and downloads video or
audio as MP3, M4A, MP4, or the original format. It handles playlists,
albums, and channels, runs a sequential download queue with pause, retry,
and bulk clear, keeps a persistent history, supports cookies.txt for
login-required sites, and keeps its yt-dlp engine up to date automatically.
Requires yt-dlp and FFmpeg on the PATH (or set their locations in
Settings).

name: dbc
description: dbc is a command-line tool for installing and managing ADBC drivers.

name: dbc
description: Native Windows database client: SQL editor with completion, result grids, query history, execution plans, server monitoring, backups and schema comparison. Passwords stay in a local encrypted vault. Ships a command-line client (dbc.exe) and an MCP server for AI tools (dbc-mcp.exe). The user interface is in Czech. The app updates itself from GitHub Releases.

name: DBeaver Community Edition
description: Free multi-platform database tool for developers, database administrators, analysts and all people who need to work with databases. Supports all popular databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase, MS Access, Teradata, Firebird, Apache Hive, Phoenix, Presto, etc)

name: DBeaverTeam
description:
Complex data management requires a comprehensive approach. An efficient data collaboration process significantly improves team productivity.
Team Edition provides a highly secure, single data solution for all teams to manage data privately in a web version and desktop app.

name: DbGate
description: Database manager for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, SQLite and others. Runs under Windows, Linux, Mac or as web application

name: DBine
description:
DBine is a desktop database manager for relational, analytical, document, key-value, graph, time-series and search databases. One workbench connects to PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, InfluxDB and many more engines.

Explore and query:
- A tree per connection and database, with saved queries kept inside each database
- A SQL editor with each engine's dialect, completion of tables and columns, and script execution
- A fast results grid with cell editing, filters, sorting, charts and a JSON tree view
- Graphical execution plans, a visual query builder and query optimization hints
- Search across object names, columns and stored code, and run code on several databases at once

Design and move data:
- Table designer, ER diagrams and script generation
- Compare schemas and data, then migrate, clone or sync databases between engines
- Import CSV, JSON, XLSX and XML; export results in many formats; generate test data and data subsets
- Rename objects with an impact analysis of everything that depends on them

Administer:
- Server monitor, live processes and a profiler of the queries clients run
- Users and permissions, backups, health checks and database properties
- SSH tunnels, including chains of bastions and the SSH agent
- Read-only connections and production safeguards

Assistant and integrations:
- An AI assistant that writes and explains queries with a local built-in model or Ollama; it never runs anything by itself
- A local MCP server so AI coding assistants can work with your connections, with every write approved in DBine
- End-to-end encrypted cloud sync of connections, queries and settings to your own account
- A script library and projects backed by git

Passwords are stored encrypted with a key kept in the system keychain, and never go into the state file or the logs.

name: dBpoweramp m4a QAAC (iTunes) Encoder
description:
Successor to mp3, m4a was championed by iTunes, .m4a is used for audio, whilst .mp4 is for
video. Internally m4a can store many sub-formats:

- Apples Lossless (know also as ALAC or ALE) this format is like Zip for audio, no
  audio quality is lost, audio decompresses identical to the source.
- Advanced Audio Compression (AAC), is a lossy compression like mp3, audio quality is
  sacrificed to gain smaller file sizes. There are many types of AAC: LC (low complexity),
  HE (high efficiency), m4p (Apples encrypted).

Currently audio purchased from Apple's iTunes Music Store is lossy AAC.

name: DbSchema
description:
DbSchema is an intuitive visual database design and management tool that helps developers and teams work smarter with relational and NoSQL databases.
With its powerful diagram editor, you can design complex schemas, explore data visually, and collaborate effortlessly—all without writing a single line of code.

DbSchema supports collaborative database design by using a dedicated internal model, which can be saved as a file and shared with team members via Git. This ensures data security and protection, keeping all information within your organization.

name: dbt Core
description: dbt Core is an open-source command-line tool that lets data analysts and engineers transform data in their warehouse using modular SQL, with built-in support for version control, testing, and documentation.

name: dbt Fusion
description: dbt Fusion is the next-generation dbt CLI engine that delivers significantly faster parsing, compilation, and execution for data transformation workflows. It connects to data platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and Redshift via ADBC adapters. Fusion can be used standalone from the command line or through the dbt VS Code extension for an integrated development experience.

name: dbt Fusion
description: dbt Fusion is the next-generation dbt CLI engine that delivers significantly faster parsing, compilation, and execution for data transformation workflows. It connects to data platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and Redshift via ADBC adapters. Fusion can be used standalone from the command line or through the dbt VS Code extension for an integrated development experience.

name: dbxcli
description: dbxcli is a scriptable Dropbox CLI for files, shared links, teams, and automation workflows.

name: dbxignore
description: dbxignore applies the Dropbox ignore marker to paths that match a .dropboxignore file. .dropboxignore files use gitignore syntax and can be placed in any folder under a Dropbox root; matching paths are excluded from Dropbox sync. Markers are written using NTFS alternate data streams on Windows.

name: ddc
description: ddc decompiles Android DEX bytecode back into readable Java. It covers DEX 035-041 including multi-dex APKs and XAPK/APKS/APKM containers, and ships more than 20 query subcommands (strings, cross-references, hierarchies, manifest, resources, per-method decompiles) that answer in milliseconds without a full run. Output is jadx-style readable, reproducible Java whose emitted files compile cleanly, and the bilingual CLI localizes its messages between English and Chinese automatically.

name: DDK - Delphi Development Kit
description:
DDK (Delphi Development Kit) is a command-line tool for managing Delphi
projects, compiler configurations, and running compilations. It shares
state with the DDK VS Code extension and MCP server via RON files on disk.

name: DDS Converter
description: DDS Converter is a free image converter for DirectDraw Surface (DDS) image files, it can help you to easily convert DDS images to other common image formats, such as JPG/JPEG, BMP, PNG and TIF/TIFF format. It can support batch conversion. In addition, this software also provides DDS image viewing function, before you begin the conversion, you can open and view the image content, that is to say, you can use it as a DDS image viewer.

name: DeaDBeeF
description:
DeaDBeeF is a modular cross-platform audio player, which runs on GNU/Linux
distributions, macOS, Windows, *BSD, OpenSolaris, other UNIX-like systems.

DeaDBeeF plays a variety of audio formats, converts between them, lets you
customize the UI in almost any way you want, and use many additional plugins
which can extend it even more.

name: Deadlock Mod Manager
description: A mod manager for the Valve game Deadlock, built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript.

name: Debian
description:
这款应用为您提供适用于 Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) 的 Debian。
您将可以使用一个完整的 Debian 命令行环境，其中包含当前稳定发布的完整环境。

如果这是您的第一个 WSL 应用程序，您可能需要先启用 WSL (或联系您的设备管理员)。
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install

安装完成后，您可以通过点击开始菜单中的“Debian”磁贴，或者在 powershell 或 cmd 中键入“debian”来启动 WSL 控制台。

要更新 Debian 环境，请使用以下命令：

$ sudo apt update
$ sudo apt dist-upgrade

此应用程序的帮助页面可在 Debian 维基中找到：
https://wiki.debian.org/InstallingDebianOn/Microsoft/Windows/SubsystemForLinux

该程序的源代码可在 Debian Gitlab 实例中找到：
https://salsa.debian.org/debian/WSL

name: Debugtron
description:
Debugtron is an app to debug in-production Electron based app.
It is also built with Electron.

name: DebugView
description:
DebugView is an application that lets you monitor debug output on your local system, or any computer on the network that you can reach via TCP/IP. It is capable of displaying both kernel-mode and Win32 debug output, so you don't need a debugger to catch the debug output your applications or device drivers generate, nor do you need to modify your applications or drivers to use non-standard debug output APIs.

Under Windows 2000, XP, Server 2003 and Vista DebugView will capture:
- Win32 OutputDebugString
- Kernel-mode DbgPrint
- All kernel-mode variants of DbgPrint implemented in Windows XP and Server 2003

DebugView also extracts kernel-mode debug output generated before a crash from Window's 2000/XP crash dump files if DebugView was capturing at the time of the crash.

Here is a list highlighting some of DebugView's other features:
- Remote monitoring: Capture kernel-mode and/or Win32 debug output from any computer accessible via TCP/IP - even across the Internet. You can monitor multiple remote computers simultaneously. DebugView will even install its client software itself if you are running it on a Windows 2000 system and are capturing from another Windows 2000 system in the same Network Neighborhood.
- Most-recent-filter lists:DebugView remembers your most recent filter selections, with an interface that makes it easy to reselect them.
- Process ID option: Toggle the display of process IDs for Win32 debug output.
- Clipboard copy: Select multiple lines in the output window and copy their contents to the clipboard.
- Log-to-file: Write debug output to a file as its being captured.
- Printing: Print all or part of captured debug output to a printer.
- One-file payload:DebugView is implemented as one file.
- Crash-Dump Support:DebugView can recover its buffers from a crash dump and save the output to a log file so that users can send you the output your Windows driver generated right up to the time of a crash.

name: Deckboard
description: Create custom computer macro shortcuts and launch them through your device. No more windows switching to open the folder or website, get Deckboard to simplify them and maximize your productivity! With OBS Studio and Streamlabs OBS supported, bring Deckboard as your personal streaming companion tool! Connect your computer to your device through local WiFi connection by entering IP address or scanning QR code.

name: Deckboy
description:
Deckboy is a native desktop application for video engineers, AV technicians and live
operators who need a reliable way to organise media, trigger cues, loop content and send
video to production displays.

Cues are arranged in a playlist with fades, loops and hold-last-frame behaviour, and sent
to dedicated fullscreen outputs with per-output area of interest, edge feathering and
warp or keystone correction. Output can leave the machine as NDI, SRT, RTMP, Blackmagic
SDI or SMPTE ST 2110, several at once. Playback is driven from a Stream Deck, Bitfocus
Companion, OSC, MIDI, Art-Net or LTC timecode.

It also converts media that will not play, reports codec, raster, frame rate and duration
for any file, normalises loudness to EBU R128, generates test patterns, and captures a
camera, window or screen as a cue. PDF, PowerPoint and Keynote decks import as one cue per
slide, with presenter and prompter views available as output types.

name: DeckSave
description: A lightweight desktop app for backing up and syncing game save files across Steam Deck, Windows PC, and Linux. Detects saves from Steam and non-Steam launchers, creates versioned backups, and syncs between devices via Syncthing.

name: Decoration
description:
Decoration - Image Editor for Batch Processing
Decoration is an image editor. Add the images to your photoset, select the effects to apply among more than 100 and click on the start button.

name: DeCypherIt
description:
DeCypherIT is a freeware utility, part of the award winning suite of Products from Cypherix®. This utility allows you to decrypt encrypted files generated by Cryptainer and SecureIT 2000.
It is very simple to use. Simply point/locate the encrypted file that has been sent to you. Enter the password. That's it!

name: DedAI Bridge
description: DedAI Bridge is a small desktop app that relays EEG data from a research headset (OpenBCI, Unicorn, Mentalab, and other BrainFlow-supported boards) into the DedAI brain-driven music platform over a secure, scoped local WebSocket. Pick a headset, confirm signal quality, and pair it with your DedAI session.

name: Deep Fathom Outpost CLI
description:
Deep Fathom Outpost is a lightweight, multi-cloud compliance CLI that collects
configuration and evidence from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Azure,
and GCP, evaluates it against policy, and projects findings into compliance
frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI-DSS, CMMC, HIPAA, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and CIS.

name: DeepChat
description: DeepChat 是一款企业级智能对话平台，基于先进的大语言模型（LLM）技术，为用户提供流畅自然的对话体验。它不仅是一个简单的聊天工具，更是一个强大的内容生成和知识管理助手。

name: DeepCleaner
description:
DeepCleaner is a professional Windows utility that helps you clean temporary files, system cache, and free up disk space. 
Features include safe cleaning algorithms, detailed scan reports, and scheduled cleaning options.

name: Deepend
description:
Deepend is a single, free, cross-platform desktop app that bundles every
developer utility you reach for — JSON, text, PDF, API, and image tooling —
running 100% offline on your machine.

Studios:
- JSON Studio: Format, repair, diff, query, redact, convert
- Text Studio: Diff, hash, encode, regex, case, frequency, random
- PDF Toolkit: Merge, split, compress, protect, sign, convert
- API Studio: Request, cURL, status codes, code-gen, load test
- PixelForge: Image editor — compose pixels with precision

Built with Tauri (~10–15 MB installer, no embedded Chromium). Every tool
runs locally. No telemetry, no accounts, no network calls.

name: Deepin Cloud Print Server
description: Deepin Cloud Print is a new printing solution developed by Deepin Technology Team. It will connect your printer to the network, and is enabled for network printing via daily used applications. Deepin Cloud Print is suitable for desktops, laptops, some tablets and other networking devices that you have authorized to print.

name: Deepin Cloud Scan Server
description: Deepin Cloud Scan is a new scanning technology developed by Deepin Technology Team. It will connect your scanner to the network, and is enabled for network scanning via daily used applications. Deepin Cloud Scan is suitable for desktops, laptops, tablets and other networking devices that you have authorized to scan.

name: DeepL
description: DeepL 翻译是快速、准确和高质量翻译的首选翻译工具。每天都有数百万人使用它在 26 门语言之间进行翻译，改善他们的沟通，并打破语言障碍。

name: DeepSeek Bot
description:
DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.

name: DeepSeek Desktop
description: DeepSeek Desktop 是 DeepSeek dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的桌面客户端：托盘常驻、关闭时提供三选对话框，启动时自动拉起 dsh 并导航到其 Web UI。应用自身与 dsh 包各自独立升级。基于 Tauri v2 + React 构建，需要 Node.js 22.19+（含 npm）。

name: DeepSeek Desktop
description: DeepSeek Desktop brings the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI and the official DeepSeek Chat website into one native desktop window. Use the title-bar switch to move between Chat and Harness without merging their accounts, conversations, credentials, or storage.

name: DeepSeek TUI
description: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek V4. It runs from the deepseek command, streams reasoning blocks, edits local workspaces with approval gates, and includes an auto mode that chooses both model and thinking level per turn.

name: Defang
description: Develop Anything, Deploy Anywhere.

name: Default Programs Editor
description: Also: autoplay settings and default programs settings ...all without fiddling around in the registry.

name: DeFi Wallet
description: Use DeFi Wallet to interact with DeFiChain. It is a wallet for $DFI, wrapped BTC, ETH, USDT. Liquidity mine, use the DEX, create masternodes, and more.

name: Defraggler
description: Use Defraggler to defrag your entire hard drive, or individual files. This compact and portable Windows application supports NTFS and FAT32 file systems.

name: Delinea Connection Manager
description: Connection Manager provides secure connections to remote servers using RDP and SSH, allowing IT teams to launch ad-hoc connections to manage sessions with remote resources. Management of multiple active sessions is easy. You can store and organize connections by adding them to your favorites and import any folder structure or connections used in other tools for a single management hub.

name: DeLive
description:
当所有其他路都被堵死时的最终选择。
当字幕导出插件失效、平台禁止下载、直播没有字幕、内容受到 DRM 保护时——系统级音频捕获是你的终极保障。
需要导出字幕或转录内容用于构建知识库、分析、调研等用途，但平台受限？DeLive 捕获系统音频，交付干净、可导出的文本，你拥有完全的所有权。
🎯 核心功能
- 🎧 系统级音频捕获 - 直接捕获系统音频输出，绕过平台限制
- 🛡️ 突破防护限制 - 适用于禁止下载、有 DRM 保护、无法导出字幕的平台
- 📺 全场景覆盖 - 直播、录播、会议、私密课程、付费内容……任何有声音的场景
- ⚡ 实时转录 - 边播放边转文字，低延迟响应
- 📢 实时字幕 - 悬浮字幕窗口，支持自定义字体、颜色、大小和位置
- 📤 导出 TXT/SRT - 简单文本文件或带时间戳的字幕文件
- 🌐 60+ 语言支持 - 中文、英文、日语等 60 多种语言
- 🔄 多 ASR 提供商 - 灵活切换，满足不同精度和价格需求
🎨 用户体验
- 深色/浅色主题 - 任意环境都能舒适观看
- 现代化界面 - 简洁无边框设计，自定义标题栏
- 开机自启动 - 电脑启动后即可使用
- 系统托盘集成 - 后台静默运行
- 双语界面 - 中文和英文界面任意切换
- 自动更新 - 自动检测和下载最新版本

name: Dell Command | Configure
description: Dell Command | Configure is a packaged software application that provides configuration capability to business client platforms. This product consists of a Command Line Interface (CLI) and Graphical User Interface (GUI) to configure various BIOS features. Dell Command | Configure supports Windows and Linux operating systems.

name: Dell Command | Update for Windows Universal
Dell Optimizer
description: Dell Optimizer improves system performance and productivity by adjusting settings for power, battery, display, collaboration touchpad, and presence detection. It also gives you access to the applications that you purchased with your new computer.

name: Dell System Update
description: Dell System Update (DSU) is a legacy Windows application that helps update BIOS, firmware, and device drivers on Dell systems. Dell recommends using Dell Command | Update for newer Windows systems.

name: Delta by eToro
description:
Delta is an investment tracking app that helps you see everything you’ve invested in, all in one place.

Delta by eToro is the next generation of the Delta Investment Tracker. It’s built for investors who want a clear overview of their entire portfolio, even when their investments are spread across different asset types and platforms.

Delta supports a wide range of investments, including:
- Cryptocurrencies
- NFTs
- Stocks and funds
- Forex currencies and indices
Our goal is simple: if it has value and it’s an investment, we want you to be able to track it.

A complete portfolio overview
Delta helps you understand not just what you own, but how your investments are distributed. You can see your portfolio broken down by asset class, view everything combined, or focus on specific parts of your investments.

Whether you invest in individual stocks, follow major indices, hold crypto assets, or mix several asset types, Delta brings everything together into a single, easy-to-understand view.

Who Delta is for
Delta is designed for:
- Investors with assets across multiple platforms
- People who want insight without managing spreadsheets
- Long-term investors and active market followers alike
Delta doesn’t replace the platforms where you invest. Instead, it gives you clarity and perspective across all of them, helping you stay informed about your overall financial picture.

name: deno
description: Deno is a simple, modern and secure runtime for JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly that uses V8 and is built in Rust.

name: Dependencies
description:
Dependencies is a rewrite of the legacy software Dependency Walker which was shipped along Windows
SDKs, but whose development stopped around 2006. Dependencies can help Windows developers
troubleshooting their dll load dependencies issues.

Dependencies currently does not recursively resolve child imports when parsing a new PE since it can
be really memory-hungry to do so ( it can over a GB even for "simple" PEs ). This behavior can be
overridden (app-wide) via a property located in "Options->Properties->Tree build
behaviour".Dependencies currently does not recursively resolve child imports when parsing a new PE
since it can be really memory-hungry to do so ( it can over a GB even for "simple" PEs ). This
behavior can be overridden (app-wide) via a property located in "Options->Properties->Tree build
behaviour".

Tree build behaviours available:

- ChildOnly (default): only process PE child imports and nothing beyond.
- RecursiveOnlyOnDirectImports: do not process delayload dlls.
- Recursive: Full recursive analysis. You better have time and RAM on your hands if you activate this setting

name: Dependency Analyzer
description: depscop is a command-line tool built with Rust that analyzes and reports on dependencies between projects, classes, and different language elements.

name: DepsGuard
description: DepsGuard hardens your package manager configurations against software supply chain attacks. It scans npm, pnpm, uv, and other package manager lockfiles and configs for security misconfigurations.

name: Depósito Digital 2025 (D2)
description: Programa de depósito digital de cuentas anuales (D2) del Registro Mercantil, para ejercicios iniciados a partir del 1/1/2025. Permite cumplimentar, validar y presentar telemáticamente las cuentas anuales (modelos normal, abreviado, pymes y consolidado, incluido el modelo consolidado ESEF) ante el Registro Mercantil.

name: Descript
description: Direct your AI co-editor to do your video editing for you, or do it yourself with intuitive editing tools. With Descript, video editing is as easy as typing.

name: DeskBox
description: DeskBox 是一款免费、开源的 Windows 桌面整理工具，借助原生质感的 WinUI 3 小组件整理桌面文件：它把桌面文件收纳进小组件、映射已有文件夹，并让常用工具触手可及，而不会取代资源管理器或改变文件本身的工作方式。基于真实文件夹的小组件使其成为 Stardock Fences 等工具的现代开源替代品，待办、快速便签、搜索、天气和音乐控制等实用功能与之相辅。应用支持 Mica 与 Acrylic 材质，本地优先存储，提供 x64 与 ARM64 版本及十余种界面语言。

name: DeskPins
description: DeskPin leaves any selected program on top at all times. Simply drag the pin to the desired program and the program stays permanently on top. So you never lose sight of what is important.

name: DeskRipple
description: DeskRipple keeps each group of shortcuts in a single folder icon on the Windows 10 and 11 desktop. The icons sit behind your windows like native icons, open into a shortcut panel on hover or click, and collapse back to one icon. Five expand styles (Grid, Column, Row, Fan, Ring), themed panels with adjustable opacity, live desktop-grid snapping, and per-monitor DPI awareness. Drag in .lnk shortcuts, .url web links, files, and Microsoft Store apps; DeskRipple keeps its own copy of each shortcut and web link, so those entries survive the original being moved or deleted. By default, dragging a desktop shortcut into a folder archives the original (it returns when you remove the entry or uninstall). Switch between named desktop profiles. Try DeskRipple free for 14 days, with every feature included. No account or payment details are required to start. If it fits your workflow, DeskRipple is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

name: DeskSentry
description: DeskSentry watches a measured region of your Windows desktop, reads text out of it with local OCR, and runs actions when it changes. Rules combine triggers, conditions and actions, driven by the screen, filesystem, clipboard, processes, log files, hotkeys or the clock. Everything runs locally, and every firing is recorded with a screenshot in a local event log.

name: DeskStitch
description:
DeskStitch is a software KVM for two Windows PCs. Screens are laid out on a desk map in millimetres,
read from each monitor's physical size, so a 4K screen next to a 1440p screen line up exactly as they
stand on the desk: no dead zones, same cursor speed everywhere. Pairing code, encrypted LAN link,
clipboard for text and images, optional audio sharing, jump keys. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time license for the host PC;
the second PC never needs a key.

name: Desktop Countdown Timer
description: Desktop Countdown Timer is a completely free countdown timer for Windows desktop, and has some very useful features. You only need to set a time, then press button "Start", a countdown timer will start immediately, very simple and easy to use. You can use this software as an alarm clock to remind you to do something, or use it as a break reminder to remind you take a break.

name: Desktop Pet
description: Desktop Pet is a small open-source desktop companion (dog, cat, fox or rabbit) that follows your mouse around the screen, sits down when it catches up, and falls asleep if you leave it alone. It lives in a fully transparent, click-through window, so it never steals focus or gets in the way of your work. No network access, no data collection.

name: Desktop Plus
description: An up-to-date fork of GitHub Desktop with additional features including multiple account support, integration with third-party Git providers, commit search, multiple stashes per branch, and more.

name: Desktop Signer
description: Desktop Signer is an application developed by Disig for creating, verifying, and managing qualified electronic signatures and seals.

name: DesktopIconToggle
description: Desktop Icon Toggle is a lightweight system tray utility that allows you to instantly toggle Windows desktop icons with a double-click.

name: DesktopKeeper
description: DesktopKeeper is the totally unique software that really works with Windows 2000/XP. Desktop Lock feature might be useful if you want to protect your desktop from unauthorized access and determine if someone shows interest in it.

name: DesktopOK
description: DesktopOK is a small but effective solution for user that have to change the screen resolution often. It is also good for windows users who often have to work with a projector on the notebook eg laptop or tablet-pc on all MS Windows! so the name is Desktop O.K. and not only Icon Save, the program has also other helpful functions for daily works on all windows os!

name: DesktopPlant
description:
This revolutionary program brings life to your desktop. Plants grow directly on your desktop and need your care just like real plants!
There are several different plants to choose from (please follow the links to learn more about the plants): Azalea, Cactus, Maple Tree, Philodendron, Sunflower

Key Features:
- Amazingly realistic growth (realistic plant development depending on water, fertilizer, environmental parameters, etc.)
- Random effects will guarantee that each plant is unique
- DesktopPlants are 3D models of a real plants with enhanced visual effects
- Optimized routines for beautiful photorealistic graphics
- DesktopPlants grow directly on the desktop - above the selected wallpaper but below the icons
- Adjustable size and position
- Many plants can be displayed simultaneously
- Silent installation and uninstallation for mass deployment
- Now with Windows 11 and 64 bit support!

name: DesktopPossible
description: DesktopPossible is a free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 10/11. It groups desktop icons into virtual frames, mirrors folders live (Portal frames, with an Explorer-style Details view and filters), and adds Note, Image and live system-info Text frames. Includes workspace profiles with hotkeys and virtual-desktop switching, a one-click desktop categorizer with optional auto-organize, SpotSearch, and theming with a wallpaper-matching Chameleon mode.

name: Desktops
description: Desktops allows you to organize your applications on up to four virtual desktops. Read email on one, browse the web on the second, and do work in your productivity software on the third, without the clutter of the windows you're not using. After you configure hotkeys for switching desktops, you can create and switch desktops either by clicking on the tray icon to open a desktop preview and switching window, or by using the hotkeys.

name: DesktopTileLauncher
description: DesktopTileLauncher lets you create tiles that open URLs in your chosen browser and profile. No telemetry; the only network activity is your launched browser.

name: DeskTuna
description:
DeskTuna is a free, ad-free desktop organizer for Windows 10 and 11. It lets you group
your desktop icons into named, colored, resizable fences with drag-and-drop.
Fences stay in place — immune to "Show Desktop" (Win+D), minimize gestures and restarts.
Includes folder portals (live folder contents as a fence), roll-up, layout snapshots
with one-click restore, full multi-monitor support, themes and automatic delta updates.
Installs per-user without administrator rights. Privacy-friendly: no personal data is
collected (anonymous usage counters only, opt-out available in Settings).

name: Detect It Easy
description:
Detect It Easy (DiE) is a powerful tool for file type identification, popular among malware analysts, cybersecurity experts, and reverse engineers worldwide. Supporting both signature-based and heuristic analysis, DiE enables efficient file inspections across a broad range of platforms, including Windows, Linux, and MacOS. Its adaptable, script-driven detection architecture makes it one of the most versatile tools in the field, with a comprehensive list of supported OS images.

Detect It Easy’s flexible signature system and scripting capabilities make it an essential tool for malware analysis and digital forensics. With traditional static analyzers often limited in scope and prone to false positives, DiE’s customizable design enables precise integration of new detection logic, ensuring reliable results across diverse file types.

Detect It Easy supports a wide range of executable and archive types, including:
- PE (Portable Executable format for Windows)
- ELF (Executable and Linkable Format for Linux)
- APK (Android Application Package)
- IPA (iOS Application Package)
- JAR (Java Archive)
- ZIP (Compressed archives)
- DEX (Dalvik Executable for Android)
- MS-DOS (MS-DOS executable files)
- COM (Simple executable format for DOS)
- LE/LX (Linear Executable for OS/2)
- MACH (Mach-O files for MacOS)
- NPM (JavaScript packages)
- Amiga (Executable format for Amiga computers)
- Binary (Other unclassified files)

name: Dev HUD
description: One glass widget, pinned to your desktop, showing live Claude and Codex rate-limit rings and burn, active AI sessions, your GitHub repos' pulse (CI, PRs, issues, releases), gateway health, and system/hardware telemetry (CPU, RAM, GPU, thermals, disks, network quality, Docker, WSL, Tailscale, and more). Built with Tauri 2 — small, native, no Electron.

name: Dev Numbers for Command Palette
description: This extension allows you to display and calculate various numerical values using PowerToys Command Palette.

name: Deva
description:
平时当聊天工具用；给它一个文件夹，它就能直接动手——看代码、改文件、跑命令。还能帮你定时做些重复的事，人不在电脑前，也能用手机接着聊。

✨ 亮点

🗣️ All in Chat
要做的事都在对话里说一句：建角色、建定时任务、记住习惯、挂载文件夹……不用翻设置页，你点个确认就办好。
🎭 多角色，各有所长
内置全能助手 Deva 和安全研究专家小码酱；也能自己建角色，每个都有独立的性格、头像和常用模型。
🤖 子智能体，自动派发多 Agent
大任务自动拆开，派给多个子智能体并行跑，不急着要结果的还能放到后台；内置通用、检索、调研、方案四种，各有独立上下文，只把结论交回来。
⏪ 改坏了能退回去
/rewind 回到任意一轮之前，代码、对话可分开恢复，回退了还能撤销。
⏰ 定时任务
一句话建任务，到点自动跑，跑完弹通知；支持每天、每周、每月、cron。
📱 IM 里接着聊
把常用的聊天工具接进来，人不在电脑前，用手机发消息就是在电脑上的 Deva 里对话。

name: Devaron
description: Devaron is a free all-in-one local development environment for Windows with Apache, Nginx, PHP per site, databases, SSL, tunnels and developer tools.

name: DevBar
description:
DevBar is a small pill docked to the top of your screen that expands into a card
when you hover it, and disappears when you don't need it. It shows the handful of
things a developer checks constantly: listening ports with one-click kill, clipboard
history, Docker containers, git status for watched repos, build freshness, what is
playing, and which Claude Code sessions are working or waiting on you. Jarvis, the
voice module, answers out loud and can act on your machine, asking first before
anything destructive.
Nothing polls while the bar is collapsed, including the blur, so it measures 0.0% CPU
at idle. No accounts, no telemetry.

name: devclean
description: devclean is a safety-first CLI that finds and selectively removes Rust targets, node_modules, framework/build/test caches, package caches, and unused Docker data while protecting Git-tracked files, backups, databases, symlinks, mounts, and Docker volumes.

name: DevDocs
description:
DevDocs.io combines multiple API documentations in a fast, organized, and searchable interface.
This is an unofficial desktop app for it.

name: DevEco Device Tool
description: A one-stop, integrated device development environment that can customize HarmonyOS components, compile and program code with just a few clicks, visually debug code, and integrate distributed features, providing for innovative and efficient development at all times.

name: DevFinder
description:
DevFinder finds files by name instantly (reads the NTFS MFT) and searches inside code with an on-disk index.
It also searches Word / Excel / PowerPoint documents and Oracle Reports (.rdf) files, supports regex,
AND / OR / NOT queries, bulk replace with backup, Explorer context menu and Quick Switch for Open/Save dialogs.

name: DeviceShelf
description:
DeviceShelf scans your local network and tells you what every device on it
actually is: vendor, type, operating system, open ports. It runs on your own
machine, and nothing about your network leaves it unless you turn that on.

Npcap is required on Windows and is not bundled: the x64 build links wpcap.dll
at load time, so the app will not start without it. Install it from
https://npcap.com/#download first. The interactive installer says so as well,
but `winget install` runs silently and skips that prompt.

Beyond discovery there is a per-device security report covering TLS, SSH, SMB
and HTTP checks, presence monitoring that alerts you when an unknown device
joins or a known one drops off, per-device bandwidth and a topology map.
AI-assisted identification is optional and uses your own API key; none is
bundled or required.

A headless server edition covers 24/7 monitoring as a Docker image, a .deb
install or a Windows service, and it is part of the same one-time licence.

name: DevKill
description: DevKill is a Windows utility that discovers processes listening on ports via native Windows APIs and lets you kill them. It auto-discovers zombie dev servers (Node, .NET, Python, PHP, Vite, and others), shows them in a modern dark Fluent UI, and lets you kill them individually or in bulk. Includes CLI mode (devkill 3000), system tray integration, and auto-refresh.

name: DevLogBus
description: DevLogBus lets local services, CLIs, Linux journal streams, and browser debugging events publish structured records into one live development log stream.

name: DevMate
description: DevMate is a developer companion CLI for project analysis, JSON tools, env checks, Git summaries, file audits, JWT helpers, system status, doctor checks, and safe process cleanup.

name: Devolutions Gateway
description: Devolutions Gateway offers a lightweight alternative to Apache Guacamole and traditional VPNs for organizations requiring secure access to remote network segments. Meant for small deployments, the standalone version is free to install and use (commercial and personal), and offers you a simple web interface as an external launcher to connect to internally hosted services via RDP, SSH, Telnet, VNC, or ARD!

name: DevOps Shield CLI
description:
The DevOps Shield CLI runs compliance assessments, manages policies and
exemptions, inspects resource inventory, and exports findings as SARIF or
JSON against Azure DevOps, GitHub, and GitLab. It talks to a DevOps Shield
API host, which you can run locally with Docker Compose or in Kubernetes.

name: DevPod
description:
DevPod is a tool used to create reproducible developer environments.
Each developer environment runs in a separate container and is specified through a devcontainer.json.
DevPod providers can create these containers on the local computer, any reachable remote machine, or in a public or private cloud.
It's also possible to extend DevPod and write your own custom providers.

name: DevProjex
description:
O DevProjex é uma ferramenta multiplataforma de «código para prompt» para Windows, Linux e macOS: uma aplicação de secretária que transforma qualquer pasta ou repositório Git em contexto limpo e pronto para IA — estrutura do projeto, conteúdo dos ficheiros ou ambos. Gerador de contexto da base de código, empacotador de repositórios ou conversor de código para prompt: seja qual for o nome, a tarefa é a mesma — preparar código real para ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Copilot ou qualquer outro assistente ou agente de IA, como o Claude Code e o Cursor, localmente na sua máquina.

Resolve um problema quotidiano do programador: um projeto real não cabe numa janela de conversa. Copiar ficheiros um a um não escala, e colar tudo de uma vez rebenta o limite de tokens — muitas vezes com chaves de API, palavras-passe e dados pessoais pelo meio. O DevProjex empacota o repositório inteiro — ou um único módulo — num documento pronto para IA, mostra antecipadamente o número estimado de tokens e — com um interruptor — oculta os segredos detetados antes de o texto sair da sua máquina.

Se até agora empacotava o código com ferramentas de linha de comandos e desejava uma forma visual de o fazer — é esta: uma árvore de ficheiros com caixas de seleção, pesquisa e filtros por nome, e uma pré-visualização em direto que se atualiza enquanto seleciona. Marcadores na barra de deslocamento mostram as correspondências da pesquisa e cada elemento ocultado num relance — vê sempre exatamente o que está a enviar.

O Smart Ignore remove dependências, caches e artefactos de build automaticamente — com base em indícios reais do projeto, pelo que os monorepos são filtrados corretamente e as pastas de código-fonte nunca desaparecem apenas pelo nome. A filtragem Git vai além do .gitignore: inclua apenas os ficheiros seguidos, ou restrinja a seleção aos ficheiros em staging, a todas as alterações atuais ou ao diff entre dois refs — ideal para enviar à IA apenas aquilo em que está a trabalhar agora. Pastas raiz, tipos de ficheiro, exclusões e ficheiros individuais alternam-se de forma independente.

A ocultação de segredos substitui chaves de API, tokens, palavras-passe e cadeias de ligação detetadas diretamente no resultado — com regras baseadas no Gitleaks. O ficheiro e o código envolvente ficam no lugar: um segredo nunca lhe custa o ficheiro inteiro, um falso positivo anula-se caso a caso na pré-visualização, e qualquer outro valor pode ser ocultado manualmente, apenas durante a sessão ou de forma permanente para o projeto, sem guardar o original. A ocultação opcional de dados privados esconde e-mails, endereços IP e MAC, números de telefone e caminhos de utilizador. Em CI, a verificação de deteções pode travar um pipeline antes da fuga — os valores em si nunca são impressos.

A compressão de código poupa tokens onde importa: declarações, assinaturas, campos e a estrutura das classes ficam intactos enquanto os corpos dos métodos são esvaziados — o código-fonte puro fica cerca de três vezes mais pequeno. A remoção de comentários e linhas em branco cobre 20 pacotes sintáticos: C, C++, C#, Go, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, PHP, Python, Ruby, Rust, Scala, TypeScript e mais. Todas as transformações se aplicam apenas ao resultado: os seus ficheiros nunca mudam.

Um motor, quatro formas de trabalhar. A GUI oferece a árvore visual e a pré-visualização. O espaço de trabalho de terminal (TUI), centrado no teclado, leva o mesmo fluxo às sessões SSH e aos servidores, com uma paleta de ações pesquisável. A CLI automatiza scripts e CI: análise, pesquisa e exportação diretamente a partir de um URL do GitHub, lista de ficheiros por pipe do git diff, conclusão automática para bash, zsh, fish e PowerShell. O servidor MCP integrado (Model Context Protocol) dá a agentes de IA como o Claude Code, o Codex, o Cursor e o VS Code acesso apenas de leitura ao seu projeto: o agente pesquisa no código e vê de imediato a que função pertence cada correspondência, lê uma única função pelo nome ou vários ficheiros num só pedido, e recebe os resultados grandes por partes. O servidor nunca sai das pastas que autorizar, abre repositórios remotos por URL apenas quando o permitir, e a sua ocultação de segredos está sempre ativa e não pode ser desligada.

Trabalhe lado a lado com o seu agente, sem rodeios. Ligue um agente num só passo — a partir do menu MCP da aplicação ou com o comando mcp connect no espaço de trabalho de terminal — e escolha um modo: «Live context» ou «Padrão». No modo Live context, o agente segue as caixas de seleção da árvore de ficheiros do DevProjex: os ficheiros e pastas marcados passam a ser a sua área de trabalho e, quando altera as caixas marcadas, o agente vê a nova seleção logo no pedido seguinte — sem reiniciar, sem copiar e colar. Os filtros da janela — tipos de ficheiro, exclusões e modo Git — definem o limite: o que ocultam fica fora do alcance do agente, enquanto qualquer outro ficheiro do projeto pode continuar a ser aberto pelo nome quando o agente precisar. No modo Padrão, o agente trabalha com todo o projeto, independentemente da janela. Ative «Ver → Atividade do agente» e os ficheiros que o agente recebeu ficam assinalados com ✦ diretamente na árvore, enquanto uma descrição flutuante indica quantas vezes os recebeu; no espaço de trabalho de terminal, ficam assinalados com a letra A. Os ficheiros relacionados mostram de que depende um ficheiro e o que depende dele.

O diário do agente («MCP → Diário…») guarda o histórico de cada sessão no seu próprio computador: o cliente e a respetiva versão, o modo, o número de chamadas, o tamanho das respostas, os tokens estimados, os ficheiros entregues, o número de valores ocultados e a duração — e ainda, para cada chamada, os parâmetros, o resultado e os avisos. Exporte qualquer sessão como relatório em Markdown ou JSON — para uma auditoria, para a sua equipa ou simplesmente para ver exatamente o que o agente recebeu. O seu código, os segredos detetados e o texto das pesquisas nunca entram no diário.

Tudo foi concebido para grandes bases de código: análise rápida, pesquisa e filtros, métricas de ficheiros, linhas, carateres e tokens estimados — mais um orçamento de tokens que faz caber os maiores ficheiros na janela de contexto de um modelo e mostra o que foi incluído, enquanto o ranking experimental ordena os ficheiros por importância ou por proximidade aos que escolher, para que o orçamento vá primeiro para o que importa. Copie o resultado para a área de transferência ou exporte-o como ASCII, Markdown, JSON e XML — ou guarde os ficheiros selecionados como cópia limpa do projeto, pasta ou arquivo ZIP: para revisão de código, ensino ou entrega de um módulo a um colega. Os perfis locais memorizam as definições de cada projeto; as ferramentas Git integradas clonam repositórios por URL, mudam de ramo e atualizam a cache. Temas claro, escuro e do sistema, atalhos nativos da plataforma, cancelamento seguro de operações longas e uma interface em 20 idiomas.

O DevProjex funciona localmente e nunca altera os seus ficheiros — apenas leitura por conceção. Sem telemetria, sem nuvem, sem conta. Para servidores e CI, existem builds headless e uma imagem Docker. Uma única aplicação de secretária multiplataforma para Windows, Linux e macOS, sustentada por mais de 17 000 testes automatizados, selecionada para o App Showcase oficial do Avalonia UI e de código aberto no GitHub sob a licença Apache-2.0.

Principais funcionalidades:
- Contexto de projeto limpo para ChatGPT, Claude e outras IA
- GUI, TUI, CLI e servidor MCP (Model Context Protocol) para agentes de IA
- Live Context: o seu agente de IA segue as caixas marcadas da árvore
- Ocultação de segredos ao nível do valor no resultado
- Ligação MCP num passo: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code
- Pré-visualização em direto atualizada durante a seleção
- Diário do agente: que ficheiros recebeu cada cliente de IA
- Ficheiros relacionados: o que um ficheiro usa e o que o usa
- Dados privados ocultos: e-mails, IPs, caminhos (opcional)
- Compressão de código: código puro cerca de 3× mais pequeno
- Smart Ignore, .gitignore e modo de ficheiros seguidos
- Filtros Git: ficheiros em staging, todas as alterações ou diff entre refs
- Abra repositórios Git remotos diretamente de um URL
- Orçamento de tokens: os maiores ficheiros dentro de um limite
- Ferramentas MCP apenas de leitura; ocultação não desativável
- Copiar ou exportar como ASCII, Markdown, JSON e XML
- Exportar os ficheiros escolhidos para pasta ou ZIP
- Pesquisa, filtros e métricas de linhas/carateres/tokens
- Remova comentários e linhas vazias: 20 pacotes de linguagens
- Local, apenas leitura, sem telemetria, 20 idiomas

name: DevSkim CLI (.NET Tool)
description:
A framework of IDE extensions and language analysers that provide inline security analysis in the dev environment as the developer writes code. It has a flexible rule model that supports multiple programming languages. The goal is to notify the developer as they are introducing a security vulnerability in order to fix the issue at the point of introduction, and to help build awareness for the developer.

Note that as of 7 February 2026, the recentmost version that Winget can create a package for is 1.0.59 despite the existence of a v1.0.70, as binaries had not been officially prebuilt for versions past 1.0.59.

name: DevSkim CLI (Library package)
description:
A framework of IDE extensions and language analyzers that provide inline security analysis in the dev environment as the developer writes code. It has a flexible rule model that supports multiple programming languages. The goal is to notify the developer as they are introducing a security vulnerability in order to fix the issue at the point of introduction, and to help build awareness for the developer.

Note that as of February 7, 2026, the recentmost version that Winget can create a package for is 1.0.59 despite the existence of a v1.0.70, as binaries had not been officially prebuilt for versions past 1.0.59.

name: devspec
description: devspec installs and synchronizes spec-driven development framework files for supported coding agents and IDE adapters.

name: DevToys
description:
DevToys helps with daily development tasks by offering a bundle of tiny tools designed to do quick, specific tiny tasks.
No need to use many untrustworthy websites to simply decode a text or compress and image.
With Smart Detection, the app intuitively selects the best tool for the data on your clipboard.

name: devtunnel
description: The dev tunnels service provides secure tunnels that developers love, and enterprises trust. Dev tunnels allows developers to securely expose local web services to the Internet, control who has access, and easily & debug your web applications from anywhere.

name: DEWALT DESIGN ASSIST
description: DEWALT DESIGN ASSIST™ (DDA) is a no cost/no fee state-of-the-art structural design software that streamlines, automates, and optimizes your concrete anchoring design process. With multiple design standards to choose from, a comprehensive library of anchors, numerous reporting options, and a wide range of design tools, simplify your design process with DEWALT Design Assist.

name: dEXE
description: dEXE accepts x86_64 ELF and PE binaries, disassembles them, lifts the assembly to an SSA-inspired intermediate representation, reconstructs control flow basic blocks, and outputs valid, compilable C99 source code.

name: dezoomify-rs
description: dezoomify-rs is a tiled image downloader. Some webpages present high-resolution zoomable images without a way to download them. These images are often tiled: the original large image has been split into smaller individual image files called tiles. The only way to download such an image is to download all the tiles separately and then stitch them together. This process can be automated by a tiled image downloader.

name: DFexplore
description:
DFexplore is a computer application used to enter, review and modify subject data, and to submit it over the internet to a DFdiscover server at the study coordinating site. This type of data entry is commonly referred to as Electronic Data Capture or EDC. DFexplore is part of the DFdiscover clinical trial management system, which also supports data collection by paper, scanned document and fax. All methods can be used in the same study. EDC has been described as having the advantage of providing immediate help to data collection users, resulting in more complete and accurate data entry, and fewer queries from the study coordinating site.
To help realize these benefits and facilitate the transition from paper forms to EDC, DFexplore has been designed with:
- intuitive navigation, using a subject binder analogy,
- data entry screens that can match the equivalent paper forms,
- help in the form of status icons, color coding, messages and interactive edit checks,
- a Query window used to read and respond to queries from the study coordinating site,
- a Reason window used to explain unusual data values (and thus avoid queries), and
- a Missing Value window used to mark fields with standard missing value codes

name: DFsend
description:
DFsend is a desktop application providing functionality for users who need to securely transmit scanned PDF study documents from a local computer to a DFdiscover study server, over the internet, without requiring direct access to a specific study database.
DFsend includes user authentication, encryption and tracking and provides a safe and reliable alternative to faxing or emailing study CRFs to a DFdiscover server.

name: Dhan CLI
description: Windows-first command line client for DhanHQ API v2 workflows including auth, funds, portfolio, orders, trades, instruments, quotes, historical candles, option chain, margins, eDIS, and trader controls.

name: DHCPLogView
description:
DHCPLogView is a tool for Windows that monitors the DHCP requests sent by every device connect to your network and displays the information on the main window.
For every device that connects your network the following information is displayed: DHCP Request Time, MAC Address, MAC Address Company, Requested IP Address, Host Name, Vendor Class ID, User Class, PRL Bytes (Parameter Request List), and the operating system of the device (For common versions of Windows and Android)

name: Dialpad
description: With Dialpad, you can connect to customers, coach customer-facing teams, & deliver amazing experiences—all with one AI-powered communications platform.

name: Dialpad Meetings
description: With Dialpad, you can connect to customers, coach customer-facing teams, & deliver amazing experiences—all with one AI-powered communications platform.

name: Diario.Avalonia
description: Un'app in avalonia e linq per contenere quello che più vi pare. Non è critttato e usa il dialetto material di google. Non usa lo stylesheet xaml di google, ma usa il ReactiveUI

name: Dichromate
description: A privacy and security focused web browser based on Chromium

name: Dictaphone
description:
Dictaphone - Voice and Audio Recorder
Record audio from your computer

name: Didder
description: didder is an extensive, fast, and accurate command-line image dithering tool. It is designed to work well for both power users as well as pipeline scripting.

name: Differ
description: Differ is a modern desktop application for file comparison and merging. It supports side-by-side diff with syntax highlighting, three-way merge with conflict detection, recursive directory comparison, and AST-based syntax-aware hunk regrouping.

name: Diffinity
description:
Diffinity is a free diff and merging tool for Windows with focus on accurate and
easy to read source code diffs. It will compare the contents of two text
files and show all differences line by line and also which individual
characters/words that differs.

Features:
- Improved diffing quality for c-style source code and xml
- Thumbnail view of all diffs
- Folder comparison
- Differentiates between changed, removed and added lines
- Instance highlighting - double click or search for a word to show all instances of it
- Syntax highlighting
- Supports unicode and auto detects encoding (and warns if encoding mismatch)
- Customizable interface with support for tabs
- Manual alignment markers
- In-line diffs live updated as you type
- Windows Explorer shell integration
- Portable (can be run directly from an external device)

name: Diffractor
description:
Diffractor is designed to manage a collection of photos and videos on your PC.
It can view and search any files, but the collection has extra features such as duplicate detection, fast search and presence. The collection is indexed to support these features.

Diffractor calculates the presence of files in the collection. The presence indicates if a file exists or is duplicated in the collection. It also indicates if an item has sidecars.
Sidecars are extra files associated with a media item – for example XMP metadata or subtitles.
The presence tooltip lists the files that diffractor has detected. Duplicates in red and sidecars in green.
Presence also works for files outside the collection. Use it to check if files on an old memory card are missing from the collection. Simply open the memory card and group files by presence.

File formats  supported by Diffractor:
- Video Encoding Formats: MP4, 3GP, OGG, WMV, WEBM, FLV, AVI, QuickTime, HDV, MXF, MPEG-TS, MPEG-2 PS, MPEG-2 TS, WAV, LXF, GXF, VOB
- Audio Formats: MP3, AAC, HE-AAC, AC3, EAC3, Vorbis, WMA, PCM
- Standard Image File Formats: BMP, GIF, JPG/JPEG, PNG, PSD, TIFF, WEBP
- Raw photo file formats: 3FR, ARW, BAY, BMQ, CINe, CRW, CR2, CR3, CS1, DC2, DCR, DNG, ERF, FFF, HDR, IA, K25, KC2, KDC, MDC, MEF, MOS, MRW, NEF, NRW, ORF, PEF, PXN, QTK, RAF, RAW, RDC, RW2, RWL, SR2, SRF, SRW, STI, X3F

name: digiCentral Archive Sync
description:
Downloads a copy of all the files sent to digiCentral onto your PC.
Key features
- Download files stored by digiCentral onto your computer
- Compatible with both Digital Tachograph and Smart Tachograph files

name: digiConnect
description:
Connect your Tachosys device to your PC
Key features
- Transfer downloaded files from digivu and digifobpro
- Update firmware on devices
- Compatible with both Digital Tachograph and Smart Tachograph files

name: Digital Detox
description:
Digital Detox is a small Windows app that locks the screen for a chosen duration, from 1 to 999 minutes.
The lock screen covers every monitor and shows a countdown; common shortcuts such as the Windows key and Alt+Tab are blocked, and the screen switches off gradually.
It unlocks by itself when the time is up, lives in the system tray and can start with Windows.

name: Diktuokle
description:
